name: WebsitePusher
author: WebsitePusher
description: Push your local WordPress changes to your live site safely. Automatic backups before every update, instant undo, and plain English controls built for non developers.
changelog: * An "Add to WebsitePusher" button on this page opens the app with the website's address and connection code already filled in, so nobody has to copy the code by hand. The code is still shown underneath for when the app isn't installed yet.
